data_source: AgRegen 5.0 — field data uploaded by producer via platform interface
provided_by: Producer (identity withheld), San José pilot field, Jalisco, México

original_files.distribution: Original uploads and filenames are not distributed.

transformations_applied: GeoJSON conversion: CSV rows mapped to GeoJSON Point features (coordinates: [Longitud, Latitud])
Field boundary: approximated from shapefile bounding box + 30m buffer; exact boundary from producer shapefile
No pH or CE values were modified, rounded, or recalculated
data_quality_notes: Point 13 (id=13, lon=-102.979557, lat=20.379856): CE = 0.87 dS/m is a notable outlier vs field mean (0.193). Retained as-is — may indicate localized salinity or measurement anomaly.
pH range 4.13–5.03 is consistently acidic across the field — no missing values.
21 of 21 points have complete pH and CE measurements.
Method column ('1:2 water') confirms all samples prepared at 1:2 soil:water ratio per NOM-021-SEMARNAT-2000.

idw_parameters.formula: z(x) = sum(w_i * z_i) / sum(w_i), where w_i = 1 / d_i^p
idw_parameters.boundary_masking: Grid cells outside field polygon masked (alpha=0)

reproducibility: All values reproducible by running: node demo/run_sanjose_workflow.js

anonymization.note: Producer first name retained. Exact field location (coordinates) unchanged. No contact details, land registry, or financial data included.
